HFE Lab

Human factors engineering tools.

Careful tools for fitting equipment and workplaces to the people who use them.

Anthropometry modellingLive Workspace Visualisation Choose an environment, put a manikin built from a real person's measurements into it, solve its posture and check the fit against editable limits: sightlines, joint angles, clearances and reach. Environments include a desk workstation, an RPAS ground control station, a busy control centre, an airborne mission crew cabin, a submarine control room, a fast-jet cockpit and a ship's operations room. Open Workspace Visualisation → Systems modellingPreview SysML v2 Editor Write a SysML v2 model as text and see its diagrams drawn as you type: definitions, interconnections, requirements and states. Requirements link to objects in Workspace Visualisation, and its check results become their verification evidence. Open the SysML v2 Editor → LibraryIn development UI Components Library The shared workspace parts behind HFE Lab tools: menus, panels, object browser, checks table, dialogs, and light and dark themes, documented so new applications look and behave the same.
